map.先按各自时区换算为同一基准（UTC）再相减，避免跨日与时差误差；结果为空中实际飞: First convert each time to a common basis (UTC) by its own zone and then subtract, avoiding date and time-difference errors; the result is the actual airborne time, excluding ground time.
map.注意：此处使用标准时区偏移，未考虑夏令时（DST）。夏令时期间部分时区会偏移 +: Note: standard time-zone offsets are used here, without daylight saving time (DST). During DST some zones shift by +1 hour.

map.北京出发 10:00（UTC+8）= 02:00 UTC，飞行 11 小时 →: Departure from Beijing at 10:00 (UTC+8) = 02:00 UTC; flying 11 hours gives arrival at 13:00 UTC. London is UTC+0, so local arrival is 13:00. Ignoring the time difference would wrongly give the next day, so always convert to UTC first and then to local time.
map.为什么要用 UTC 中间算？: Why use UTC as an intermediate step?
map.跨越多个时区直接计算易错。正确做法：出发时间转 UTC → 加飞行时长得到达 U: Computing directly across several time zones is error-prone. The correct method: convert the departure time to UTC, add the flight duration to get the arrival UTC, then convert to the arrival local zone. This tool follows that process to avoid off-by-a-day errors.
map.飞行时长含滑行和时差吗？: Does the flight duration include taxi time and the time difference?
map.飞行时长指空中时间（轮挡到轮挡常含滑行），不含时差；时差只是显示换算。实际行程还: Flight duration refers to airborne time (block time often includes taxi), not the time difference; the time difference is only a display conversion. The actual itinerary also adds check-in, immigration and ground transfer time.
